plugins.name: autofeature
plugins.description: Build an entire feature end-to-end from a single prompt. Pipeline: interrogate → scope → product-review → plan → branch → implement (parallel specialists) → test → review → ship. Includes /fullrun, /seo, and the review lenses unified under /review [product|feature|market|scope] (also available standalone: /product-review, /feature-review, /market-review, /scope).
